text:
Jordan: Handoff incoming, I'm off at 02:00 UTC. TL;DR: deployed embeddings-worker 1.3 canary at 01:40 UTC, canary shows higher GC pause tail and a small bump in ingest 5xxs around 01:45. No user-facing errors reported yet.

Jordan: Details:
- PR: https://redwood.internal/ci/PR/4128 deployed to 10% traffic at 01:40 UTC.
- Observed: embeddings.gc.pause_ms P99 went from ~120ms -> ~740ms on the two canary pods between 01:44-01:46.
- ingest.5xx.rate spiked to 0.9% for ~3m (baseline ~0.1%).
- embeddings.queue.depth increased from 3 -> 18 for ~6m, now back to ~4.
- No DB failovers; replica_lag < 1s.

Jordan: Likely causes: increased batch sizes from partner ingest + new per-request vectorization path in 1.3 causing transient memory pressure. Infra did not report host-level OOMs.

Watchlist (escalate if sustained):
- embeddings.gc.pause_ms P99 > 500ms for >5m -> rollback canary.
- ingest.5xx.rate > 1% sustained 5m -> open channel and consider rollback.
- embeddings.queue.depth > 20 for >3m -> investigate backlog.

Action items:
- Priya: take first 90m watch (02:0003:30 UTC). If GC P99 stays >500ms, flip canary to 0% and notify #deployments.
- Liam: monitor autoscaler & node CPU. If pods get CPU-throttled or nodes spike, coordinate with Infra Team.
- Jordan: I'll stay reachable for the first 30m to help triage if needed, then offline.

Priya: Taking the watch. I'll set a temporary alert to email me at 02:05 and post here if thresholds hit.

Priya: Quick checklist I'm running if things look bad:
```
# recent logs from canary pods
kubectl -n prod logs deployment/embeddings-worker -c runtime --since=20m | grep -i "gc pause" -n
# heap + threads summary
kubectl -n prod exec -it svc/embeddings-metrics -- curl -sS localhost:9100/heap
# rollback to previous revision
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/embeddings-worker
```

Liam: I'll watch autoscaler. FYI Infra Team scheduled a kernel patch on two GPU hosts at 03:15 UTC (low impact window). If you see capacity dips around 03:15-03:25, that's likely it. Infra Team: pls post if they throttle.

Infra Team: Confirmed. Patch window 03:15-03:25 UTC for gpu-spot-*. We'll throttle networking if any host shows IO issues. Low chance of impact.

Oncall Bot: Reminder: Priya is oncall 02:0008:00 UTC. Pager policy active. :bell:

Jordan: Two pro-tips before I go: (1) don't merge PR #4140 (metrics label rename) until telemetry tests pass; it can break alerting. (2) If you rollback, add a short note: "rollback embeddings-worker PR#4128 due to GC tail" in #deployments.

Priya: Acknowledged. I'll also monitor ingest.tokenize.errors and post hourly status here unless something urgent pops up.

Liam: If I see autoscaler flapping I'll add a temporary limit to the HPA and call Infra.

Jordan: Thanks all, leaving logs saved under /var/logs/embeddings/canary-01-40. Night team 375.

Priya: On it. Posting updates here if I flip traffic or see sustained anomalies.
